data.title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Ethereum L2 Abstract to shut down after losing ‘tens of millions’
data.summary_raw: Abstract, the Pudgy Penguins-backed Ethereum L2, will shut down on Dec. 15. Users must bridge assets off before then.

data.title: Conduit sues Tether over $2.76 million freeze, says it has ‘no legal entitlement’ to funds
data.summary_raw: Conduit is suing Tether in NY federal court, alleging the USDT issuer froze $2.76 million of its funds for over a year without explanation.

data.title: Winklevoss group seeks to launch Zcash ETF with 0.25% fee, proposed WINK ticker
data.summary_raw: Winklevoss Asset Services filed for a spot Zcash ETF under ticker WINK, with Gemini as custodian and a 0.25% fee, rivaling Grayscale's ZCSH.

data.title: Solana treasury DeFi Development authorizes CHAD preferred stock buyback program
data.summary_raw: Solana treasury firm DeFi Development approved an open-ended program to repurchase CHAD preferred stock if it trades below its $10 par value.
